question: Can the shared cash ledger value holding, reducing, resizing or reversing supplied incumbent base inventory relative to immediate flattening without counting a fresh entry for every hour?
scope: Exact supplied algebra and regression controls only; no market access, fitting, parameter selection, orders or edge promotion
law: Target quantity earns its interval price change and marked funding; charge absolute target-minus-incumbent quantity at entry price and terminal liquidation at exit price. Sunk pre-entry cash is excluded.
comparison: Each action's adverse surplus is its lower cash minus immediate-flatten upper cash. Upper surplus is action upper minus flatten lower. Identical flatten action has exactly zero surplus; no signed-side contrast.
funding_boundary: At an entry or resize boundary enclose monotone partial quantities between before and after; unchanged inventory is held, terminal liquidation includes held-to-flat. Independent uncertainty differences are conservative, not attainable joint extrema.
causal_state: Require supplied incumbent state timestamp no later than the decision and decision strictly before modeled entry, plus a state-source digest. These declarations do not authenticate state or features.
controls: Flat prices and no funding: holding one existing base unit costs terminal liquidation only, while opening the same unit costs entry and exit; hold-minus-flatten is zero, not minus a second entry fee.
Price change 100 to 200 with incumbent quantity one: holding retains one unit and does not silently rebalance to half a unit; an explicit resize to half charges the half-unit trade.
Reversal from plus one to minus one trades two units, not one; partial funding entitlements enclose both signs.
Positive funding at a same-sign resize boundary cannot become income or assume the inventory was flat; old/new adverse debits remain.
All existing fixed-base replay tests and legacy stateful behavior remain unchanged.
Malformed state, duplicate actions, absent flatten comparator and nonpositive costs reject before evaluation. Source, state, action and cost mutations change the canonical binding.
admission: Supplied single-instrument horizon-liquidation counterfactual only. Not a continuous Bellman objective, neutral hedge, fill evidence, native account PnL, admissible training batch or trading policy.
terminal: Retain exact controls and source identities; do not interpret passing accounting checks as profitability or repeat consumed financial screens.
